title: Khanjar Tale Ali ka
body:
khanjar talay ali ka laal
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ka ek sagheer tha
sookhe galay par teer tha
baysheer tashna reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
pamaal dulha jab hua
armaan khaak mein mila
maqtalmen naushah reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
mashkeeza ran mein chid gaya
farkhe jari bhi shaq hua
abbas pyasa reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
barchi jo akbar ko lagi
laila ke dil ko ched di
zakhmi kaleja reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo naujawani ka safar
barchi ka phal lakhte jigar
dil mein andhera reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde mein sar hai pesh e rab
shukre khuda mein khole lab
khanjar bhi chalta reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
<<DIVIDER>>
iqbal wo zehra ka gham
sabir ke dil pe hai raqam
har baar naama reh gaya
pyasa tadapta reh gaya
khanjar talay...
author: Iqbal Abedi
